'''Tempersteel''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] building material. The cashier wall at [[Pentastar Trust and Safety Assurance Bank]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Entralla/Legends|Entralla]] was constructed of tempersteel.
